title: The Silence of Milton Flats
author: Quentin Halloran
blurb: Edmund Whitlock, a letter-writer sending postcards to an address that burned down years ago, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. But when a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
